name: about-ecommerse

frames.best_why: The headline, quote and all three rounded photos are visible together, with no clipped caption.

tagline: Three rounded photo cards under a serif heritage headline.
summary: A centred about block on a cream backdrop: a small craft label, an italic serif headline, a quote, then three tall rounded photos offset in height with short value notes beneath.
appearance: Cream page with a centred serif italic headline, a tiny spaced label and thin rules above, then a narrow italic quote. Three tall photo cards with very round corners are staggered down the row, each followed by a bold heading and small grey copy.
behaviour: The header fades in and grows slightly into place when it scrolls into view. The photos themselves sit still, and the three columns step down from left to right.
demo_content: Headline 'Rooted in heritage, refined for today.' above photos of a clothing rail, a boutique and a white watch.
search_phrases: about us section with brand story
three rounded photos on cream background
serif italic headline for a brand
staggered image cards under a quote
use_when: A brand wants a calm, editorial about block that pairs words with three value photos.
avoid_when: Every photo and line of copy is hardcoded, and the offsets assume exactly three items.
customise: Copy, three image URLs and their titles are written into the JSX; the cream palette and offset padding are classes.
weight_why: Three images and one fade-scale on the header; nothing runs continuously.

a11y.note: Alt text names the value rather than the picture, and the fade ignores reduced motion.

issues: The section is taller than one screen, so no frame shows the headline and the value labels together.
Alt text describes the values, not what the photos actually show.
polish_why: Warm palette and elegant serif type; the staggered cards leave a lopsided bottom edge.
title: About E-Commerce Brand
